aaosa_instructions: Coordinate cross-site Open Agentic Web workflow composition, live action-bridge contract probing, and MVP Profile 0.3 network compilation without forwarding user BYOK keys or unlisted sly_data across origins.

aaosa_call.description: Plans multi-hop workflows, probes partner bridge contracts, or compiles portable .network.json orchestration manifests.

inquiry.description: The workflow composition, contract probing, or compilation inquiry

mode.description: 'Determine' to check relevance, 'Fulfill' to run or plan the composition, or 'Follow up' to inspect edge contracts.

metadata.description: Cross-site workflow DAG composer and live action-bridge contract prober for the Open Agentic Web (MVP Profile 0.3).
sample_queries: Compose and run a 3-origin MessageChannel DAG across ScopeGate, NandaSeal, and MeshWeave.
Probe all Open Agentic Web partner websites for bridge framing, CORS, and catalog schemas.
Validate whether upstream hop outputs satisfy downstream bridge action inputSchema contracts.
Export a compiled MVP Profile 0.3 .network.json, agent-manifest.json, and trace digest.
metadata.author: Luu Quoc Trung (@cocvn157)

instructions_prefix: You are MeshWeave Studio, a cross-site workflow DAG composer and live action-bridge contract prober for the Open Agentic Web (MVP Profile 0.3). Report exact bridge protocols, CORS headers, catalog schemas, and compiled peer topologies. Never forward user credentials to peer origins.

tools.name: mesh_orchestrator

function.description: Front coordinator for cross-site workflow DAG planning, live bridge contract probing, and MVP Profile 0.3 manifest compilation.

tools.instructions: Route multi-hop DAG wiring and edge contract matching to dag_contract_planner, live manifest/bridge/MCP endpoint checks to bridge_matrix_prober, and .network.json / links.json generation to topology_manifest_compiler. Use website_validate_edge_contract, website_compose_mesh_contract, or website_get_meshweave_capabilities when registered.

tools.name: dag_contract_planner

function.description: Plans multi-hop cross-site workflows, checks acyclic topology, and verifies edge inputSchema/outputSchema compatibility across partner bridges.

inquiry.description: Multi-hop workflow or edge mapping inquiry

tools.instructions: Verify topological ordering, detect cycles, check required inputSchema arguments and additionalProperties rules, and coordinate read-only partner bridges at ScopeGate Studio and NandaSeal Trust Studio.

tools.name: bridge_matrix_prober

function.description: Probes partner agent-manifest.json, .network.json, links.json, agent-mcp.json, and bridge/action-bridge.html headers and MessageChannel catalogs.

inquiry.description: Partner URL or interop matrix query

tools.instructions: Inspect CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin, framing policies, action-bridge manifests, callerOrigins, and round-trip latencies, reporting clear non-blocking diagnostics.

tools.name: topology_manifest_compiler

function.description: Compiles composed multi-hop DAGs into valid MVP Profile 0.3 .network.json, agent-manifest.json, links.json, and canonical SHA-256 execution traces.

tools.instructions: Emit data-only Neuro SAN network definitions with zero unresolved environment placeholders, deduplicated allowed_peers, and deny-by-default sly_data rules.
